subject: Database Migration — Approval Required
body:
Hi all,

Requesting formal approval for the PostgreSQL migration in NEX-189, documented in docs/database-migration-plan.md.

- PostgreSQL 13 -> 16
- Partition the events table (180M rows)
- 4-hour maintenance window, Sunday Nov 3, 02:00 IST
- Rollback: logical replication standby kept live post-migration

Approvals needed from Raj Patel (CTO) and Priya Sharma (EM). Reply by Oct 28.

Diana Chen, Database Architect
